dependence.rule: For a positive total, the result FAILS if removing the single best day or the single best trade leaves a total <= 0. Worst-day removal is reported as a diagnostic (mean-reversion shape), not a gate.

full.rule: Stage 6 three-way Monte Carlo on per-trade results in time order (R or money): RESHUFFLE = same trades, random order (total fixed; tests order luck: where the real drawdown ranks among shuffled ones); RESAMPLE = draw trades with replacement (tests trade luck: share of runs that end <= 0); RANDOMIZE = drop each trade with probability drop_fraction and charge every kept trade an extra cost drawn uniformly from [0, 2 x extra_cost] (tests the broker; drop-only and cost-only runs are reported separately so the two causes are not mixed).
